intent: Extend CAP-0007's existing epistemic-trajectory composition with one optional bounded Judgment-context phase that invokes CAP-0004's already-existing grounded rationale/revision persistence executor after Judgment persistence and before Outcome evaluation. The orchestrator must validate the CAP-0004 receipt but must not reimplement Judgment relation semantics. The storage-semiconductor later-vintage run will use this phase to relate the July 2023 SK hynix NAND-reduction Judgment to the earlier October 2022 guidance in the same fresh PostgreSQL execution.
rationale: CAP-0004 already owns and implements grounded Judgment rationale/revision relations in judgment_context_projection.py and execute_grounded_judgment_context.py. CAP-0007 already owns phase ordering and explicitly allows a bounded execution phase when another capability owns the semantics. The observed need is composition only: broker runs use fresh PostgreSQL, so earlier and later Judgments must be recreated together and the existing CAP-0004 context executor invoked in the same trajectory. A campaign-specific relation writer would violate unique semantic ownership.
